evidence_snippets: Code customization, a feature in Gemini Code Assist Enterprise, lets you get code suggestions from Gemini Code Assist Enterprise that are based on your organization's private repositories, and thus aligned to your organization's coding style.

With code customization, developers can use remote context from your organization directly in the IDE, as the following diagram shows: As you code, Gemini Code Assist searches your private index for code that is similar to what you're trying to write.
Code customization supports repositories hosted on github.com, gitlab.com, bitbucket.org, and on-premises repositories hosted on GitLab Enterprise, GitHub Enterprise, and Bitbucket Data Center.
